author: Ogrey
body:
The Game: Slendercraft
Slendercraft is basically a concept that could *possibly* work as a gamemode here in Avicus, if executed properly.
Basically, you spawn in a map (of course, there'd be some maps, and community would be able to submit their own maps too, just like in any other gamemode), your mail goal is to gather the required items to escape the map, Slenderman, and therefore, win the game.
The player count is 8 players per game, as searchers, and 1 of them gets to be Slenderman. The goal is Slenderman is to haunt and murder the searcher players through the entire map before they're able to gather the required objects and win.
Sounds pretty basic, right?
Here's some other things that you should know:

Timer
As the game starts, the timer begins its countdown. It can be as much as 5 minutes initially, to 2 minutes, depending on the difficulty of the map. As the time decreases, your chances of winning become lower, since if your timer reaches 0, searchers automatically lose.
However, as you keep gathering the required items to escape, your timer will increase! Don't get too happy though, you might not be able to find the next item, after all :^)

Items
Items  you need to gather in order to win the game. Mainly, you'll have to gather the usual 8 pieces of paper hung on walls, pick them up, and once they're all gathered, run to the exit and escape & win. However, not every map will necessarily require you to gather 8 pieces of paper. As an alternative method, you'll be required to gather a random number of gas cans to power up your vehicle (you use it to escape the map) and win. What is the difference? You'll have to bring every single gas can back to the start of the map, or wherever the vehicle is located, and interact with it to make the gathered item count as one. What else there is? An elevator key. You'll have to search through the whole map for a single key, yeah, just one. That's it. Just a simple elevator key. The difference here is you'll have to bring it to the elevator, use it, make it count, and then you'll have to wait for the elevator to activate itself, which may take a while, and you may be dead when the elevator finally decides to activate itself! Not to mention if you stand still in a spot or a designated area for too much, you'll most likely be dead!

Maps
Me and Skyadia will soon (as soon as my computer gets fixed... ouch) start working on a few maps for this. I'm pretty sure there's no possible way in our current YML system to incorporate this gamemode idea, however, I'll seek out for a solution to this matter. Like SG, you'll spawn in some sort of "lobby", where you'll have to vote for a map. This helps making sure there's a total amount of 9 players before the game starts (8 searchers, 1 slender) and, of course, players get to choose the map they wanna play, out of a pre-selected list of maps, haha. Don't worry though, I can assure you the chances of dying in all of them will be the same, if not higher! Doesn't this sound amazing? xd

Abilities
As a searcher, you'll a single ability (I'm sorry lmao I can't think).
Haste to speed yourself up in case Slenderman is about to murder you and tear your soul apart from your body. It'll have an energy bar that indicates whether you are able to use Haste or not. If you use it too much, the energy bar will decrease, however, if you take a break from it, it'll gradually increase back.
As Slenderman, you'll have a couple abilities.
You'll have innate Night Vision, Speed, Strength & Resistance. Seems pretty op, right? It is! and it's meant to be! After all, there'll be 8 vs 1. No fair (not to mention you'll most likely never be able to kill Slenderman since you start the game with no weapons, and I honestly have no plans of adding any. You're welcome <3)
You'll have Teleport. Can be used up to 3 times (starters), and it teleports you to a random location in the map. If you're lucky, you might appear next to a player, if not, you just end up being more far away. Nice!
You get Darkness. Can be used up to 3 times (starters), and it allows you to temporarily blind a player (searcher) for a given amount of time. It may be your chance to murder them, after all. [Targetable - you get to pick your target].
You get Rage. Can be used 1 time (starters), provides additional Strength and Speed. Lasts for barely any time at all, use it to finish someone.

Upgrades
As a searcher or Slenderman, you'll be able to spend your credits in certain upgrades for you to boost your abilities in-game.
You can upgrade Haste to Strong Haste or Swift Foot. Strong Haste makes the ability last longer (more energy), and Swift Foot allows you to run faster. Strong Haste can be upgraded to Ultimate Haste for even longer lasting (even more energy), and Swift Foot can be upgraded to Flash Foot for ever more speed (but no more energy).
Teleport can be upgraded to increase the Teleport Count from 3 to 4, then from 4 to 5.
Darkness can be upgraded to increase the Darkness Orbs from 3 to 4, then from 4 to 5.
Rage can be upgraded to increase the Rage Potions from 1 to 2. That's it.

Credit
Basically, most of it was made using Slender Fortress (Team Fortress 2 fanmade mod & servers), that has presumably closed now... (rip). I thought it'd be cool to have something similar around Avicus, so why not?

I'll be more than glad to answer questions.
I'm also open to suggestions and criticism and long as it doesn't offend anyone.
If you read everything, thanks! If not, I suggest reading before asking any questions ;^)
